rejected.B: Lean coat silhouette reads as a passer-by; the narrow column loses the effort/weight read needed for cranking a reel.
rejected.C: Cape + brim make a strong shape but hide both arms and the task; identity becomes weather, not work.
rejected.D: Hood hides the face needed for the reaction beat and the bib leaves an unresolved gap at the hips; long limbs weaken the stocky weight read.

acceptance: At full display size the stocky torso, flared vest hem, wide trousers and forward lunge are distinct from the other three candidates.
At one-tenth size the bob head mass, vest block and split stance still read as a working adult bent toward something low.

review.reviewer: Claude (model visual review; final artistic approval reserved to Manmeet)
observations: Pass 1 rejected: knee bow-tie self-intersections (compiler bend-side bug), arms hooked over heads (IK branch), parallel legs (pose semantics).
Pass 3: A/B/C/D read as four different people at 1/10: rounded bob + flared vest mass (A), narrow coat + top-knot (B), brim hat + triangular cape (C), peaked hood + waders (D).
A: lunge with forward bent near knee and planted back leg reads as effort over a low object; broad sloped shoulders and vest flare give a stocky field-worker identity.

Defects carried forward: near hand not yet constructed so the arm reads as a stub; head is a single bob mass (fringe/face to come from the view-registered face design); D's bib leaves a white gap at the hips (not selected).
